title: Rescheduling Dilemma in the Academic Affairs Meeting

scenes.description: Wendy, a 30-year-old nutrition professor, sits at a long table in the conference room, her hands clasped tightly together. Across from her, Academic Director Irene flips through a printed schedule, while Tom, a middle-aged colleague, leans forward with a thoughtful expression. The room is filled with the usual hum of academia, but tension is palpable as the topic of Wendy’s upcoming travel plans and class schedule conflict arises.

actions.dialogue: Wendy, I need to discuss the cancellation of your first class this week. Your travel plans are conflicting with your teaching schedule, and we need a resolution. Can you confirm if there are any updates on your trip?

Thank you for bringing it up, Irene. I’m still waiting for a confirmation from the conference organizers. I had hoped to attend this event for my research, but I don’t want to compromise my teaching responsibilities.
What if we arrange for a substitute to cover the first class? That way, you can still go on your trip, and the students won’t be left without instruction.
That’s a good idea, Tom. I just need to make sure the substitute is well-prepared for the topic. I don’t want to leave the students in a lurch.
I appreciate your responsibility, Wendy. But we need a firm plan by the end of the day. If you can’t attend the first class, we need to act quickly.
I’ll reach out to Tom to see if he can recommend someone for the substitution. I’ll also confirm my travel plans and let you know as soon as possible.

scenes.plot: During an academic affairs meeting at EKU Danville Campus, Wendy is asked by Academic Director Irene to address a conflict between her travel plans and a scheduled class. Colleague Tom suggests a substitute to help her maintain her professional responsibilities while attending the conference. Wendy weighs the options, showing her thoughtful and responsible nature, and agrees to work with Tom to find a solution.
scenes.social_purpose: The interaction highlights Wendy’s struggle to balance her academic duties and personal interests, while showcasing her professional ethics and the dynamics of her relationships with colleagues and superiors.
